title: Merged cells grid ods 001
notes: real ODF spreadsheet merges (same covered-cell model as the odt merged builder, ODF 1.2 §9.4, under office:spreadsheet): one 3x3 table (table:name MergedGrid): A1 spans two rows (table:number-rows-spanned="2") with a covered:table-cell placeholder in the same column of row 2, A3 spans two columns (table:number-columns-spanned="2") with a covered:table-cell to its right in row 3; covered: is the mandated prefix for the table namespace URI. The normative counter reads table:table=1. Reference text lists each surviving cell's text once in row-major order (covered cells carry no text).
